products.name: Ghostly Valentine
products.description: A gentle ghostly bracelet inspired by love that lingers beyond time.
products.lore: Some love stories never truly end. Ghostly Valentine carries quiet echoes of affection that remain long after memories begin to fade.

products.name: Whispering Willows
products.description: A woodland-inspired bracelet filled with quiet forest magic.
products.lore: Ancient willow trees are said to whisper forgotten stories to those willing to pause and listen.

products.name: The Seer's Secret
products.description: A mysterious treasure inspired by forgotten prophecies and hidden futures.
products.lore: Hidden behind velvet curtains and crystal visions, The Seer's Secret is inspired by ancient fortune tellers, whispered predictions and the mysteries that time has yet to reveal. This treasure invites its keeper to embrace curiosity, trust their instincts and remember that the future is never truly written in stone.

products.name: The Moonlit Relic
products.description: A quiet keepsake inspired by moonlight, reflection and wonder.
products.lore: Bathed in the gentle glow of the moon, The Moonlit Relic captures the peaceful beauty of the night sky. Inspired by moonlit walks, quiet reflection and timeless wonder, this treasure is a reminder that even in darkness there is beauty waiting to be discovered, and every new night carries the promise of another dawn.

products.name: Stormflower
products.description: A delicate bracelet that celebrates quiet strength and gentle growth after the storm.
products.lore: Stormflower is born from weathered petals and soft resilience, a small talisman for the moments when beauty rises from the rain.

products.name: When the Stars Listen
products.description: A calm bracelet inspired by wishes whispered into the quiet of a starry night.
products.lore: When the Stars Listen was made for those who pause and speak softly to the sky, carrying hope on every bead.

products.name: Beyond the Veil
products.description: A mysterious bracelet that hints at hidden paths and the quiet magic beyond sight.
products.lore: Beyond the Veil is a gentle reminder that not everything must be understood at once; some discoveries are meant to be revealed slowly.

products.name: Forged in Flames
products.description: A bold bracelet built from ember-bright energy and steady strength.
products.lore: Forged in Flames captures the courage of new beginnings, combining heat and heart in a single handmade treasure.

products.name: Wings After Winter
products.description: A soothing bracelet that evokes first flights and gentle renewal after cold days.
products.lore: Wings After Winter is made for the hopeful return of warmth, with soft beads that whisper of new beginnings.

products.name: Dusk Before Dawn
products.description: A deep bracelet inspired by the hush between night and the first light of morning.
products.lore: Dusk Before Dawn carries the quiet promise that even the darkest hour is followed by a new beginning.

products.name: Ashes of Hope
products.description: A hopeful bracelet that holds the quiet glow of new possibilities after loss.
products.lore: Ashes of Hope is a subtle reminder that even when embers fade, a gentle spark can still light the way forward.

products.name: Lost in Moonlight
products.description: A lost moon, caught gently in a thread of blue.
products.lore: Something about a moon that became lost after wandering too far from the night sky — eventually finding its way onto a little thread of blue and refusing to leave.
materials: Royal blue Korean waxed polyester cord
Originally made using 32 cm of cord.

products.name: Unsung Melody
products.description: A forgotten melody given new life as something unexpected.
products.lore: There was once a song that nobody remembered. Its record was left behind, its melody slowly fading into silence. Then, somewhere between the grooves, a little flower appeared. Perhaps the song wasn't finished after all.
materials: Originally made using 32–33 cm of cord. As each bracelet is handmade and finished with an adjustable sliding knot, the finished size may vary.
